summary: Iter-143 frontend verification of the searchable shipping-company picker in FinancialInputHub → 'دفعة شركة شحن' tab. Both paths exercised: (1) EMPTY-state on the live merchant (0 shipping companies) — focus the input shows ship-company-empty with the correct Arabic hint, free-text typing keeps the value, clear-button resets it, and the form remains submittable with required fields. (2) POPULATED path simulated by seeding 2 companies (سمسا, أرامكس) via direct POST /api/shipping-accounts/{name}/payments — the dropdown then rendered exactly 2 rows with bold names + emerald 'لك عليه: {abs(remaining)} ر.س' badges + sub-line (الطلبات / مجموع المستحق / مدفوع) all matching GET /api/shipping-accounts. Picking سمسا filled the input and rendered ship-company-balance-card with 'لك عنده 100.00 ر.س'. Form POST returned 200 and the list refreshed.
action_items: Optional cleanup: my seed left two test shipping accounts on the merchant — سمسا (total_paid=100, remaining=-100) and أرامكس (total_paid=200, remaining=-200) — both notes='seed for iter-143 test'. No DELETE endpoint exists for individual shipping payments (returned 404). Main agent or a follow-up cleanup script should null these out if they pollute production reports.

Pre-existing (NOT introduced by iter-143) React hydration warning persists: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' from emergent x-* dynamic instrumentation injected into the bank <select>'s <option> children (FinancialInputHub:1223). Same as iter-138/142.
critical_code_review_comments: ShippingPaymentForm useEffect fetches /api/shipping-accounts on mount AND again after every successful submit (line ~1096). Good. But the displayed input value uses `form.company_name || query`, which can create UX confusion: after a pick, query is cleared but `form.company_name` is set; then if user clicks back into the input and types, the onChange overwrites `form.company_name` directly with the new chars (line 1110) — so the old picked name is lost as soon as the first keystroke fires. Acceptable since they're switching companies, just note that the balance-card disappears the moment they start typing.

filteredCompanies sorts descending by remaining then slices to first 12. For merchants with many companies, the cap of 12 is fine, but if a merchant has >12 companies AND the one they want is past 12 alphabetically, they MUST type to find it (no scroll). The placeholder hints this with 'ابحث'. OK.

Free-text fallback works (verified by submission with non-existent name 'شركة_غير_موجودة_123') but the backend appears to normalize/strip suffixes (POSTing سمسا_تجربة stored as سمسا). This is backend behavior, not a frontend concern, but worth flagging if a merchant deliberately wants suffix-distinguished names.
test_credentials: amasi.jewelery@gmail.com / 10201917 (preview merchant). At test time merchant had 0 shipping accounts initially; testing agent seeded 2 (سمسا, أرامكس) via direct API.
seed_data_creation: Seeded 2 shipping payments via POST /api/shipping-accounts/{name}/payments — سمسا (100 ر.س) and أرامكس (200 ر.س), both with note='seed for iter-143 test'. Backend does not expose a DELETE for individual payments (returned 404), so these persist until manually cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Route is /financial-input-hub. Shipping tab testid=hub-tab-shipping. The merchant now has 2 seeded shipping accounts (سمسا, أرامكس) with negative remaining (over-paid against zero orders). The picker testids work as documented in the review request. The shipping-payments backend appears to NOT have a DELETE-by-id endpoint for individual payments, so cleanup must be done at DB-level if needed. Backend POST /api/shipping-accounts/{name}/payments accepts paid_from_account_id=null gracefully (just shows the warning toast). The hydration warning about <span> in <option> is from emergent's x-* instrumentation, not from product code.
rca of the issue: No defects. The picker correctly: (a) fetches /api/shipping-accounts on mount, (b) renders ship-company-results when companies exist + matching query, (c) renders ship-company-empty when query yields zero matches, (d) preserves free-text input (form.company_name || query), (e) fills the input + balance-card on pick, (f) re-fetches accounts after a successful POST. Badge colors and balance-card text match the sign of remaining exactly as coded (rose if >0.005, emerald if <-0.005, slate if ~0).
